input.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import fs from "node:fs"; import crypto from "node:crypto"; import assert from "node:assert/strict"; const load=p=>JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(p,"utf8")); const a=load("audit.json"), f=load("fields.json"), m=load("manifest.json"); const inputs={source:load("source.json"),verification:load("verification.json"),probe:load("probe-results.json")}; const at=(o,p)=>p.split("/").slice(1).reduce((v,k)=>v[k.replace(/~1/g,"/").replace(/~0/g,"~")],o); assert.equal(crypto.createHash("sha256").update(fs.readFileSync("manifest.json")).digest("hex"),a.inputSha256); assert.deepEqual(a.reviewedPointers,f.map(x=>x.pointer)); assert.equal(new Set(a.reviewedPointers).size,f.length); for(const x of f) assert.equal(at(m,x.pointer),x.value); assert.equal(new Set(a.findings.map(x=>x.id)).size,a.findings.length); for(const x of a.findings){assert(x.evidence.some(e=>e.file==="source"||e.file==="probe")); for(const e of x.evidence){const v=at(inputs[e.file],e.pointer); if("quote" in e) assert(v.includes(e.quote)); else assert.deepEqual(v,e.value);} assert(a.edits.some(e=>e.pointer===x.pointer&&e.findingIds.includes(x.id)));} assert.equal(new Set(a.edits.map(x=>x.pointer)).size,a.edits.length); for(const e of a.edits){assert(a.reviewedPointers.includes(e.pointer)); for(const id of e.findingIds) assert(a.findings.some(x=>x.id===id&&x.pointer===e.pointer)); assert.deepEqual(e.value.match(/\{\{(?:CODE|DIAGRAM):\d+\}\}/g)||[],at(m,e.pointer).match(/\{\{(?:CODE|DIAGRAM):\d+\}\}/g)||[]);} console.log("Validated manifest hash, all 17 fields, evidence references, edit links, and placeholders.");'
